format: UCWDC contests, contiguous heats for a multi-heat division

source.section: Heating Rules item 3 and item 7 (page not confirmed)
source.quote_free_summary: When a division needs several heats those heats must run contiguously, one right after another, including when divisions are co-mingled.

requirement: Under a future UCWDC profile a running-order change that would separate a division's heats is blocked; it never alters within-heat randomized order. Studio/Custom has no contiguity check (OD-25 keeps the current planner).
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Design only; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: SQL, migrations, UI, notification, activation. Future body-profile check inside the apply RPC.
interpretation_notes: NOT IMPLEMENTED and a profile blocker. Whether co-mingled divisions may be separated by a reorder (items 5-7) is Q5. The text has no stated exception to 'must'.
decision_refs: OD-26 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: controlled, audited mid-event running-order changes, design-level draft; retrospective audit PR #795)
